class.name: SteamTextEntry
class.brief_description: The user's decision from a Steam modal keyboard.
class.description: Read this result after awaiting [method SteamDevice.enter_text].

members.member: Whether the user accepted the dialog. An accepted empty value still counts as submission. A dismissal has [code]submitted = false[/code].
Submitted text, or an empty string when the user dismissed the dialog. Hidden mode masks characters during input and still returns the submitted value here.
